metadata.case_name: LAU CHI KEUNG v. WONG WAI KEI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: soft tissue contusion injury to the dorsum of his right foot
source: I accept the joint medical opinion of Dr. Hung and Dr. Lam that the Plaintiff sustained a soft tissue contusion injury to the dorsum of his right foot.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified parts of foot

source: The diagnosis was neuropathic pain of right foot.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified nerve at ankle or foot level

source: I am prepared to give him the benefit of doubt by finding that he does suffer from a mild adjustment disorder as a result of the Accident.

injuries.description: apparent 5-8 mm nodular bony density with surrounding radiolucent “ring” over the superolateral corner of the navicular bone suggesting changes of osteochondritis; benign bony spur protruding from the superolateral part of his medial cuneiform bone; accessory navicular and small ossicles
injuries.body_part: navicular / medial cuneiform region of both feet (accessory navicular noted in right foot)
source: However, apparent 5-8 mm nodular bony density with surrounding radiolucent “ring” was present over the superolateral corner of the navicular bone, suggesting changes of osteochondritis. Benign bony spur was also seen protruding from the superolateral part of his medial cuneiform bone.
Radiological examination of both feet showed osteochondritis of navicular bony spur in both feet. There was an accessory navicular in the right foot.
MRI scan of the right foot was performed on 7 August 2009 and showed that the bony prominence is found to be due to small ossicles. In fact, similar ossicles are also present on the left side.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: swelling over the dorsal region of his right foot
tenderness over dorsum of right foot
could walk unaided for short distance; needs a stick for long distance walking
mild residual pain on prolonged standing or weight bearing
insomnia, irritable mood, frequent argument with his wife, low mood and anxiety, poor sleep, occasional irritability; problem in his sex life

source: At first, the Plaintiff received treatment from a bonesetter.
He was treated with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug and was discharged home on the same day.

treatments_received.treatment: conservative treatment with medication, physiotherapy and occupational therapy
source: He was treated conservatively with medication, physiotherapy and occupational therapy. The response was unsatisfactory.

treatments_received.treatment: superficial and deep peroneal nerve block (28 March 2008)
source: The superficial and deep peroneal nerve block was given on 28 March 2008 with unsatisfactory response.
He was referred to the Pain Clinic on 18 July 2008.

treatments_received.treatment: MRI scan of the right foot (7 August 2009)
source: MRI scan of the right foot was performed on 7 August 2009 and showed that the bony prominence is found to be due to small ossicles.
He had been receiving acupuncture therapy from pain clinic and he thought his pain condition had not improved.

losses.description: Could walk unaided for short distance but needs a stick for long distance walking; mild residual pain on prolonged standing or weight bearing
Irritable mood and frequent argument with his wife

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Reported problem in his sex life causing additional distress
